_provenance.notes: Bering Sea sea ice extent critically affects groundfish and crab productivity. Low winter ice = reduced cold pool = northward shift of pollock and other species. The 2018-2020 period had record low sea ice extent, associated with mass crab mortality. SST data for southern Bering Sea shelf (56-60°N, 160-175°W).
